user.title: Location
user.description: Choose the observing location. Coordinates are validated against Open-Meteo before the integration is added.

preset.title: Scoring preset
preset.description: Choose how strict the scoring should be, and your preferred darkness for a usable night. The darkest chosen tier is used when it's reachable; otherwise the window falls back to a shallower one so a night is never skipped.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to contact Open-Meteo. Check the coordinates and try again.
